correctness.rationale: A fixed incidence edge has exactly (1,2q,2q²,q³) ordered partner edge counts. By the projective plane axioms the four geodesic laws are |U-V|, U+V, 1+U+V and 3−|U+V−1|, with no missed shorter endpoint route because incidence girth is six. Their triangular densities yield the three formula pieces and integrate to 1; polynomials give the moments. For q<r the density ratio on j+u is (m_q/m_r)(r/q)^j (1+(r−1)u)/(1+(q−1)u), strictly increasing and matching at t=1,2; CDF and W1 consequences follow. Independent q=2,3 direct edge-pair enumeration and moment integral tests pass; the plane-axiom proof is what covers non-Desarguesian planes.
